title: Macro Deck Battery widget data (v1)
description: Describes the JSON stored in WidgetEntity.Data for a Battery widget (WidgetType.Battery).
$comment: No top-level 'required' and additionalProperties left unset on every object, for the same reasons as the other widget schemas: a fresh widget's data is near-empty, and older or newer clients may write keys this schema does not know. Device ids are the host's qualified battery ids ('<provider>:<device>'); the widget draws at most eight devices.

mode.description: Which devices the widget shows: the one in 'device', every device the host knows (default), or the ones in 'selection'.

devices.description: The picked devices, in display order. Only the first eight are drawn.

style.description: How each level is drawn: a full ring around the device icon (default) or a horizontal bar.

showPercentage.description: Whether the level is written as a percentage. Absent or null means true.

showName.description: Whether the device name is written. Absent or null means true.

showChargingBadge.description: Whether a charging device shows a lightning bolt. Absent or null means true.

colorMode.description: How the level is colored: by 'thresholds' (default) or with the single 'color'.

thresholds.description: The level bands used while 'colorMode' is 'level'. Absent or null uses red below 20, orange below 40, yellow below 60 and green from 60 percent.

chargingColor.description: Whether a charging device is drawn in cyan instead of its level color while 'colorMode' is 'level'. Absent or null means true.

color.description: The level color as #rrggbb while 'colorMode' is 'single'; the accent color when absent or null.

backgroundColor.description: Widget background color, as #rrggbb or transparent. Absent or null keeps the widget's default background; transparent also removes the deck's tile behind the widget.

border.description: Outline drawn along the widget edge.

flows.description: Press-trigger action flows, stored the same way as an Action Button's. Stored on the wire as a nested JSON string; the editor may show it inlined as an array. Both forms are accepted here.

deviceReference.description: A battery device as the widget stores it, so a device that is not reporting can still be named.

id.description: The host's qualified battery device id.

name.description: The device name when it was picked.

kind.description: The device kind when it was picked, such as phone, headphones or watch; picks the icon.

colorThresholds.description: A numeric range divided into colored bands, the value a thresholds editor writes. Each band runs from its 'from' up to the next band's; the first band has no 'from' and covers everything below the second.

id.description: Stable, non-empty key, unique within the value.

color.description: The band color, as #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa, or a Color variable reference such as {{ vars.primary | color }}, which the host resolves before a widget reads it.

from.description: Where the band starts; strictly increasing, absent on the first band.

widgetBorder.description: Outline drawn along the inner edge of the widget.

style.description: Visual style; absent, null or 'off' means no border. The color-tinted styles are static, heartbeat, breathing, blink, comet and ants; hue-shift and rgb ignore color.

color.description: Ring color for the color-tinted styles. Falls back to a default color when absent or null; ignored by hue-shift and rgb.

actionFlow.description: One action-flow entry (a trigger and its action blocks). Its internal structure is deliberately not validated here - deep flow validation is out of scope for this schema.
